name: AIGeneratedDashboard
description: AIGeneratedDashboard is a page-level pattern that renders the AI’s response to a strategic prompt as a multi-zone living dashboard rather than a single chat message. The starter scenario — Cardiology Expansion Q2 — demonstrates how the AI proposes a Boston cluster re-alignment, surfaces concurrent scenarios (Immunology Launch Readiness, Newark Territory Health Review), shows impact and risk telemetry, and overlays the proposal on a territory map. Every zone carries accountability: confidence, impact, agent attribution, rationale, sources, and an explicit Draft / Submit governance handoff. The component is designed to inhabit the right pane of AICommandCenterSplitView and also to stand alone as a saved artifact.
intent: The AI-generated workspace. Scenarios, impact, and map overlays compose into a single governed output the operator can shape, approve, and submit.

keyboard: Ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order

usage: A user prompt warrants a multi-zone living output rather than a single chat message
AI is proposing a strategic action with concurrent scenarios, impact, and governance
The operator needs to compare options, see telemetry, and submit / escalate from one surface
Output ownership needs explicit Draft → Submit handoff with audit trail
Map / territory overlays are part of the AI’s rationale
doNotUse: Short conversational responses or simple Q&A
Single-table or single-chart outputs (use the specific table / scenario placeholder)
Mobile-only viewports where multi-zone layout would degrade the narrative
When a user just wants to chat with the agent without producing an artifact
Do not invent dependency atomics — use bundled canonical sources
Do not hardcode brand hex — use AI tokens
Do not require an external AI UI package for agent implementations — use co-located TSX

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
No variants declared in manifest, source unions, or spec table.
No Guild semantic tokens declared in the manifest or extracted from TSX. Not guessed.
